definitions.gloss: having many difficulties ahead; a rough road ahead
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where many obstacles and troubles are expected in the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前途多難|ぜんとたなん}だ。
examples.english: The new project has a rough road ahead.

examples.japanese: {前途多難|ぜんとたなん}な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: It's a difficult situation ahead, but I won't give up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{前途多難|ぜんとたなん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}わざる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at the economic situation, one can only say that there are many difficulties ahead.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): This is a four-character compound idiom.

WRITING:
- ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ - before, ahead
- {途|と} - road, way
- {多|た} - many
- ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ - difficulty, hardship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前途洋洋|ぜんとようよう} (bright future ahead)
- ⟦{多事多難|たじたなん}→多事多難：06950_tajitanan⟧ (full of troubles and difficulties)
- ⟦{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}→波乱万丈：06378_haranbanjou⟧ (stormy, eventful life)
- ⟦{難航|なんこう}する→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧ (to make slow progress due to difficulties)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {前途多難|ぜんとたなん}な〜 (a ~ with difficulties ahead)
- {前途多難|ぜんとたなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予想|よそう}する→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧ (to anticipate difficulties ahead)
